name: Little Children
overview: Scripture reveals that little children are a precious heritage from the Lord, entrusted to parents as a divine reward (Psalms 127:3). They are to be lovingly disciplined and trained in the way of the Lord, ensuring they remain faithful throughout life (Proverbs 13:24; 22:6). Jesus emphasizes the humility and trust exemplified by little children as essential for entering the kingdom of heaven (Matthew 18:3) and welcomes children to come to Him, highlighting their special place in God's kingdom (Matthew 19:14). Additionally, the blessings of children extend beyond one generation, bringing honor to both the young and the old (Proverbs 17:6).
